csv_project_name: CM/GC for Lake Forest Park Roadway & Station Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The Central Puget Sound Regional Transit Authority (Sound Transit) is requesting a Statement of Qualifications and Proposed Approach (SOQ) from qualified proposers to provide Heavy Civil General Contractor/Construction Manager (HC-GC/CM) Services for the construction of the BT306 Lake Forest Park SR 522 (Bothell Way NE) Roadway & Station Improvements ( Project ) contract. This project consists of Arterial Widening (roadway, sidewalks, signals, structural walls & Misc utilities) for Bus Rapid Transit (ST Stride) providing 6 new stations located along Bothell Way NE (SR522 from NE 145th Street in Seattle to Ballenger Way NE (SR104) in Lake Forrest Park. Firms interested in this HC-GC/CM contract may submit a SOQ in accordance with the requirements set forth in this RFQ/PA.

title: CM/GC for Lake Forest Park Roadway & Station Improvements
short_description: CM/GC services for roadway widening and six BRT stations along SR 522.
project_scope: Construction of the BT306 Lake Forest Park SR 522 (Bothell Way NE) Roadway & Station Improvements contract for Bus Rapid Transit (ST Stride). The project includes arterial widening with roadway works, sidewalks, traffic signals, structural walls, and miscellaneous utilities, plus 6 new stations along Bothell Way NE (SR 522) from NE 145th Street in Seattle to Ballenger Way NE (SR 104) in Lake Forest Park.
services: Heavy Civil General Contractor/Construction Manager (HC-GC/CM) services; requested disciplines include civil engineering, construction/project management, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a construction management/general contractor procurement, not a direct structural design commission.
- Includes some structural engineering content through structural walls and station-related infrastructure.
- Transportation corridor and station improvements are relevant only to a limited extent for sbp.
- No notable long-span, bridge, roof, or architecturally demanding special structure is described.
- Large project volume may offer strategic teaming opportunities, but overall fit is moderate to low.

fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated. This is a CM/GC procurement for construction-phase services rather than a clearly defined structural design fee scope.
references_qualifications: Qualified proposers must provide a Statement of Qualifications and Proposed Approach for HC-GC/CM services.
